timing: frozen before any main generation in the new fully concurrent cohort; the earlier sequential cohort was stopped before evaluation and is separate
primary_outcome: observed task success: technical completion AND architectural compliance AND frozen content criteria AND required objective evidence; missing assessment is unknown, never silently success
unknowns: report separately, show known-only rate and lower/upper descriptive bounds; primary observed success fraction uses all planned units
paired_primary: compute proven task successes/5 for each of 40 scenarios and architecture; compare three paired scenario fraction differences, B minus A, in percentage points

bootstrap.method: paired percentile cluster bootstrap; resample 40 whole scenarios with replacement preserving five repetitions and three architectures

paired_test.method: two-sided paired sign permutation of scenario success-fraction differences; remove zero differences; exact enumeration up to 16 nonzero differences, otherwise Monte Carlo with plus-one p adjustment
paired_test.multiplicity: Holm over all three success comparisons; alpha=0.05; no favorable comparison selection

secondary_outcomes: unique physical requests, distinct agent roles, invocations, domain calls, specialist-as-tool invocations, peer delegations and explicit messages
core latency and collector end_to_end_latency_ms separately; API latency separately; judge latency separately
input/output tokens and estimated USD costs per run and observed success
latency_summary: median of five attempts per scenario, then median and IQR across scenarios; completed and technical-failure latency distributions separate; do not exclude legitimate unfavorable content; measurements under concurrent mixed load are descriptive and distinct from the earlier sequential protocol
cost_policy: estimated token cost from physical request ledger, base input and output tariff; unknown usage remains unknown with known partial sums explicit; generation/judge/recheck/connectivity/pilot/API separated; never actual invoice
failure_classes_priority: invalid or missing content judgment preventing classification
both content and mandatory evidence failure
failure_classes_scope: one exclusive primary class for each nonsuccess; overlapping semantic/critical indicators explicitly labelled

recheck.selection: before content judgment: one cell per architecture × five historical categories, seeded random response selection as existing select_rechecks; seed 20261011; preserve primary; no favorable substitution
recheck.interpretation: same automated judge stability, no human/pharmacist review

history: keep v4.1, v4.2, v4.3 and v4.4 cohorts separate; the main table is the fresh v4.4 run only
limitations: sampling intervals conditional on this scenario collection
generation_schedule: 600 new isolated first attempts in balanced waves, 48 workers; preserve the v4.2 planned order and admit complete scenario-repetition triplets
evaluation_schedule: same calibrated semantic judge; 48 independent blind workers after generation, plus 15 frozen stability checks
comparator_scope: v4.2 workflow and swarm, including coordinator and final synthesizer; only the centralized supervisor policy changes

parallel_amendment.reason: user requested maximum practical concurrency for generation and evaluation; all main units share the same mixed-load design
